payload.text: **LESSONS candidates, 2026-09-18 afternoon, vc's call at a fold (drop is the expected outcome -- todo 63).** (a) **Todo 71(a) recurred at once:** dc's 12:03Z WP-03 re-review went unanswered across vc's 12:08Z message AND the fold after it. Only the pickup's live-message list found it. Before sending any message to a peer, read that peer's unhandled messages first. (b) **Replacing a tool swaps its environmental inputs too:** git archive read the COMMIT's attributes, while checkout-index reads the WORKING TREE's. The replacement fixed export-ignore and silently let a later eol attribute rewrite a tagged release (dc found it). When swapping a tool, list what the new one reads that the old did not. (c) **The pre-commit gate does not run check lint:** 9196ca3 committed an SC2016 breach that only a later check all found. Run check all before every commit that touches shell.
